en: Upekkhāsahagataduka (The Pair on Accompanied by Equanimity)
Dependent on a state not accompanied by equanimity, a state not accompanied by equanimity arises by way of root condition … three.
Dependent on a state not accompanied by non-equanimity, a state not accompanied by non-equanimity arises by way of root condition … three.
Dependent on a state both not accompanied by equanimity and not accompanied by non-equanimity, a state not accompanied by equanimity arises by way of root condition … three. (Abbreviated.)

In the case of the root condition, there are nine; ... pe ... in the case of the prenascence and repetition conditions, there are six; ... pe ... in the case of the non-disappearance condition, there are nine.
